q22.

**Dispatcher:** `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (internally delegating to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) — `repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`

```14:17:repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
// DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook dispatches a webhook when a memo is created.
func (s *APIV1Service) DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx context.Context, memo *v1pb.Memo) error {
	return s.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook(ctx, memo, "memos.memo.created")
}
```

**Delivery package:** `internal/webhook` (`repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go`) — the handler calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)`, which performs the actual HTTP POST via `Post`.

**Signing mechanism:** [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com/)-style HMAC-SHA256 signing. A per-request `webhook-id` and `webhook-timestamp` are generated, an HMAC-SHA256 digest is computed over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body` using the webhook's signing secret, and the base64-encoded result is sent as `webhook-signature: v1,<signature>`:

```139:149:repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go
		msgID := "msg_" + uuid.New().String()
		timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10)

		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
		mac.Write([]byte(msgID + "." + timestamp + "."))
		mac.Write(body)
		signature := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

		req.Header.Set("webhook-id", msgID)
		req.Header.Set("webhook-timestamp", timestamp)
		req.Header.Set("webhook-signature", "v1,"+signature)
```
